# VS/Positron Extensions

## [Quarto Wizard](https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-wizard/)

```sh
positron --install-extension mcanouil.quarto-wizard
```

# Quarto Extensions

## [Quarto Acronyms](https://github.com/rchaput/acronyms)

Run the below in `manuscript` to install the extension to `_extensions`.

```sh
quarto add rchaput/acronyms 
```

Then add as a filter to frontmatter (in this case we have to add it to _quarto.yml or else it will look for the filter in `/supplementary/`), and define some acroynms:

```yml
---
filters:
  - acronyms
acronyms:
  keys:
    - shortname: TLA
      longname: Three-Letter Acronym
    - shortname: STOP
      longname: Source To Outcome Pathway
---
```

We can then invoke these acronyms with either Latex-style commands `\acr{KEY}` or newer Quarto shortcodes `{{< acr KEY >}}`. Frankly, both of them impair readability.

Anyway, Acronyms will display key and value for the first time we use an acronym ({{< acr TLA >}}) and subsequently just show the short version ({{< acr TLA >}}).

Unfortunately, it doesn't currently support mouse hover to show definitions.
